errorPattern: Unable to find entry point for .*`<my-widget>`\.
reason: real Marko treats an unresolved hyphenated tag as a failed custom-element lookup ("Unable to find entry point for custom tag `<my-widget>`") and refuses to compile -- verified against @marko/compiler 5.42.5 / marko@6.3.51. Fixed: @mxlang/html's emitSpecial now rejects an unresolved hyphenated name with Marko's own wording, instead of rendering it as literal HTML. Under the MX 1 subset rule (decision 71/72) this could later become a supported divergence -- see divergences.md "candidates for MX 2: unknown custom elements in the vanilla host".
